title: chore: introduce `html` module
body:
## Summary

This PR introduces an `html` module in InstantSearch.js ([FX-1512](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1512)).

It will be exposed via the Template API later on.

## Review

For now, this addition shouldn't impact the library, and doesn't require a release. It can be merged without waiting for other PRs.
